{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders removed: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Drop refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
print(f"Number of refunded orders removed: {refunded_mask.sum()}")

# Only keep completed orders that are not QA or refunded
df_clean = df[~qa_mask & ~refunded_mask].copy()

# Check channel distribution after cleaning
df_clean_channel_segment = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
print(f"Cleaned channel by customer_segment:\n{df_clean_channel_segment}")

# Compute conversion rate by channel (only on completed, non-QA, non-refunded orders)
conversion_rate_email = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
conversion_rate_paid_search = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

# Compute difference
diff = conversion_rate_email - conversion_rate_paid_search

print(f"Conversion rate (email): {conversion_rate_email:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate (paid_search): {conversion_rate_paid_search:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {diff:.4f}")"}
